scheme_name: NIT Startup – National Institute of Technology Incubation Seed Fund
overview: The NIT Startup – National Institute of Technology Incubation Seed Fund is a scheme under AICTE aimed at supporting EduTech startups through incubation and seed funding. It is designed to foster innovation and entrepreneurship among students and faculty in technical institutions by providing financial and non-financial support for early-stage ventures. The scheme focuses on nurturing innovative ideas that contribute to national goals like Atmanirbhar Bharat and Viksit Bharat@2047. It operates under the AICTE Productization Fellowship (APF) initiative, which supports innovative ideas driving future economic growth.
objectives: Support innovative ideas that drive future economic growth
Contribute to the nation's vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat and Viksit Bharat@2047
Promote innovation and entrepreneurship in technical institutions
Support EduTech startups through incubation and seed funding
Encourage industry-academia collaboration for technology development offting innovation
Provide financial and non-financial support to early-stage ventures
Foster a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship among students and faculty
Support translational research and lab-to-market initiatives
eligibility: The scheme is open to students, faculty, and startups from AICTE-approved institutions. Applicants must be part of an AICTE-approved institution and have an innovative idea in the EduTech sector that aligns with national goals like Atmanirbhar Bharat and Viksit Bharat@2047. The idea should be in the early stage and require incubation and seed funding support.
benefits: The scheme provides financial support in the form of seed funding, incubation support, mentorship, access to infrastructure, industry-academia collaboration opportunities, and guidance for product development and market readiness. It also offers networking opportunities with investors and industry experts, and support for scaling innovative EduTech solutions.
financial_support: The scheme provides seed funding to selected EduTech startups through the NIT Startup – National Institute of Technology Incubation Seed Fund. The financial support is provided as a grant or seed investment to help startups develop their product, conduct market validation, and scale operations. The exact quantum and mechanism of disbursement are not specified in the evidence.
application_process: 1. Register on the AICTE portal for the AICTE Productization Fellowship (APF) initiative. 2. Submit an application for the NIT Startup – National Institute of Technology Incubation Seed Fund through the designated portal. 3. Provide details of the innovative EduTech idea, team, and institution. 4. Submit required documents including proof of institution approval, team details, and project proposal. 5. Await evaluation by the selection committee. 6. If selected, receive seed funding and incubation support.
required_documents: Any additional documents as specified in the application guidelines
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted year-round as per the AICTE Productization Fellowship (APF) initiative timeline.
implementing_agency: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)

Only startups from AICTE-approved institutions are eligible

Continued funding may be contingent on progress and milestones
